lines.text: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep,
like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.
He put them to everlasting shame.
He rejected the tent of Joseph
and refused the tribe of Ephraim.
But He chose the tribe of Judah,
He built His sanctuary like the heights,
like the earth He has established forever.
and took him from the sheepfolds;
from tending the ewes He brought him
to be shepherd of His people Jacob,
So David shepherded them with integrity of heart
and guided them with skillful hands.

pictures.scene: Giovanni Lanfranco, Elijah Awakened by the Angel — the sleeper touched and raised up to stand again, but their widows could not lament, then the Lord awoke as from sleep
pictures.name: pd_lanfranco_elia_gewekt

pictures.scene: Philip James de Loutherbourg, The Defeat of the Spanish Armada — the great fleet broken up and driven off the way it came, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine, He beat back His foes
pictures.name: pd_loutherbourg_armada

pictures.scene: Eugène Fromentin, Campement dans le Sahara — the camp struck down in the open sand and left behind, He put them to everlasting shame, He rejected the tent of Joseph
pictures.name: pd_fromentin_campement_sahara

pictures.scene: Jean-François Millet, Le Vanneur — the winnower throwing the grain up so that the chosen falls back into the basket, and refused the tribe of Ephraim, but He chose the tribe of Judah
pictures.name: pd_millet_le_vanneur

pictures.scene: Karl Friedrich Schinkel, Gotischer Dom am Wasser — the sanctuary raised up high over the water where everyone can see it, Mount Zion which He loved, He built His sanctuary like the heights
pictures.name: pd_schinkel_dom_am_wasser

pictures.scene: Joos de Momper the Younger, Mountain Landscape — the mountain standing where it was set and not moving, like the earth He has established forever, He chose David His servant
pictures.name: pd_momper_mountain_landscape

pictures.scene: Charles-Émile Jacque, Shepherdess tending her flock — the keeper standing among the ewes and watching over them, and took him from the sheepfolds, from tending the ewes He brought him
pictures.name: pd_jacque_shepherdess_flock

pictures.scene: Giuseppe Pellizza da Volpedo, Il Quarto Stato — the whole people coming forward together behind the ones who lead them, to be shepherd of His people Jacob, of Israel His inheritance
pictures.name: pd_pellizza_quarto_stato

pictures.scene: Thomas Eakins, Max Schmitt in a Single Scull — the one man holding his own line on the open water with steady hands, so David shepherded them with integrity of heart, and guided them with skillful hands
pictures.name: pd_eakins_max_schmitt
